name: services/blobbox/delete

arguments.name: blob_ids
arguments.description: Pipe-separated list of blob IDs (no more than 500). You may only delete blobs which you have uploaded yourself. All other blob IDs will be ignored.

arguments.name: format
arguments.description: Format in which to return values. See supported output formats.

arguments.name: callback
arguments.description: Required only if you've chosen jsonp as a return format.

returns:
A dictionary of the following structure:

  • matched - list of blob IDs which were actually deleted (they still existed and were owned by you).

    Note, that if you set expiry times for your blobs, then they might have been deleted automatically before you called this method.
